analysis.title: Alpine Ease Landing Page
analysis.notes: A centered landing-page interface overlays a luminous alpine valley with painterly mountains, wildflowers, and atmospheric depth. Soft rounded controls and restrained dark typography create a calm, approachable contrast against the expansive natural hero image.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a full-bleed cinematic alpine valley at golden hour, viewed from a low meadow filled with colorful wildflowers in the foreground. Layer rolling green hills, a small rustic cabin, towering sculptural mountain faces, and distant peaks beneath a pale blue-to-peach sky. Use soft atmospheric haze, painterly realism, gentle bloom, warm sunlight on the grass, and slightly blurred foreground flowers to create depth and tranquility. Compose the scene with generous open space near the upper center for interface overlay, while keeping the landscape richly detailed around the edges. No text, logos, people, or recognizable brands.
